2. Short facts are that the petitioner as plaintiff instituted Title suit No.3 of 1985 in the Court of Subordinate Judge (now Joint District Judge), Kushtia against the opposite party Nos. 1-3 for declaration of title to the suit land stating, inter alia, that the suit land appertaining to CS Khatian No.174 belonged to Bholai Shah Fakir and Sital Shah Fakir in equal share and the CS record was accordingly prepared and finally published. After the death of the said CS recorded tenants Pari Nesa, Abdul Gafur. Elach Nesa, Osiran Nesa, Noorjahan and Amena Khatun inherited the suit land. For non payment of rent landlord filed Money Suit No. 728 of 1944 against the tenants and got a decree, The landlord put the decree into execution in Execution Case No. 1991 of 1945 and the suit land was put into auction on 11-12-1945. Ismail Hossain Shah Fakir. Secretary Ullan Shah Committee, purchased the suit land in auction. The auction sale was confirmed on 13-2-1946 and possession was delivered through court on 7-6-1946. The suit land appertaining to CS Khatian No. 227 Plot No. 263 also belonged to Bholai Shah Fakir and Sital Shah Fakir, The share of Bholai Shah Fakir was owned by Lalan Shah Committee and later on plaintiff got that share, In this way the plaintiff got 1.43 acres of land from CS Khatian No. 177 and 0.12 acre of land from CS Khatian No.227 and have been in possession. At the time of SA Operation 0.77 acres of land out of 1.43 acres of land was correctly "recorded in the name of the plaintiff in Khatian No.191 but 0.30 acre of land was wrongly recorded in the name of Chomar Promanik, the predecessor-in-interest of the defendant Nos. 4-12 in SA Khatian No.418 and 0.50 acre of land in Plot No. 259 was wrongly recorded in the name of Omed Ali in SA Khatian No.193. The plaintiff had no knowledge about the wrong record, When the defendants claimed the suit land on 1-10-1984 on the basis of wrong record the plaintiffs were constrained to bring the suit. 

 3. The defendant Nos. 1-3, 4-12 and 13-16 contested the suit by filing three separate sets of written statements. They denied the material allegations made in the plaint. The case of defendant Nos. 1-3, in short, is that before 1952 the Mazar of Lalon Shah was insecured. In 1952 the then Deputy Commissioner of Kushtia and Mr AZM Rezaul. Advocate as the Secretary formed an organization under the name of Lalon Loko Sahitia Kendra and Mr Mozammal Haque was made the Secretary of the Organization. At that time the boundary wall and other constructions were made at a huge cost with the fund provided by the government and the then government and non-government organisations and the then governor of the then East Pakistan opened the same ceremonially. After liberation of country the then Member of Parliament Mr Golam Kabir took over the charge of the Sahitta Kendra as its head but after he was killed the development work of the organisation was slowed down. In 1976 the Deputy Commissioner, Kushtia was made the Chief Executive of the Kendra. The Constitution of Kendra was amended and it was renamed as Lalon Academy. In the written statement filed by the defendant Nos. 4-16 on 10-9-1985 It was stated, inter alia, that the CS recorded tenant of Khatian No.174 Bholai Shah while had been in possession of 1.77 acres of land in various plots died issueless leaving behind his widow Parinessa who inherited his share. Sital Shah Fakir died leaving behind his heirs. Abdul Jabbar who inherited his share Pari Nessa and Jabbar Ali Fakir settled 0.50 acres of land out of Plot No. 259 with defendant No.13 Nader Ali Mollik and Omar Ali Sarder father of defendant N 0.14 by an amalnama on 24th Kartik 1349 BS and delivered possession. Nader Ali has been living there by constructing dwelling houses and one Mulsem Hossain Shah Fakir used to collect rent from the defendant by giving receipt on behalf of La Ion Shah Dargha Committee during the period 1352-1362 BS Umed Mollik transferred his share to one Munshi Md. Chand Ali by a registered kabala dated 3-7-1356 but did not deliver possession of the transferred land and then the defendant Nos.14-16 on payment of kabala money to Munshi Chand Ali Mollik got a deed of reconveyance and to the knowledge of all including the plaintiff SA Khatian No.193 has been prepared in the name of Umed Ali and Nader Mollik.
